ADS ratio to 1 ADS : 15 ord. shares
Functions like a 1-for-15 reverse ADS split; price per ADS should rise proportionally, aiding listing compliance.
Sets the trading date when price and CUSIP adjustments take effect.
Fractions will be sold; holders receive net cash, affecting small positions.
No change to company market cap or equity structure, just ADS mechanics.

This is a capital markets mechanics move often used to lift per-ADS trading prices and maintain listing standards. A larger catalyst would be confirmation of sustained bid above compliance thresholds and any subsequent operational or financial updates.
